lines.en: I float half a block off the ground.
For all this bulk, I move light.
I skim low over the ground.
Dust trails along behind me.
My pace runs twice a man's.
See that? I need not use my legs.
I brush past the treetops.
This ground is too small for my stride.
Something up ahead is moving.
I walk and hunt for ki at the same time.
My soles never touch soil.
The wind pulls my sash straight.
I hang in the air with my arms crossed.
This planet smells awful.
I roll my neck.
A power level of twenty-two thousand; not much.
I wait for orders from above.
Who would waste time here?
My horn catches the sun.
I am getting bored.
The insects here are irritating.
I yawn.
My fingers drum on the bracer.
If I am to fight, make it interesting.
I glance at the far sky.

lines.zh: 脚下一块石头被我踩碎。
lines.en: A stone crumbles under my foot.

lines.zh: 你这样的，我一眼就能看出战斗力。
lines.en: Your kind I can size up at a glance.
Pathetically low.

lines.zh: 你站得挺直，倒有点意思。
lines.en: You stand straight; that is something.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西伤不了我。
lines.en: That thing in your hand cannot hurt me.
Sweat gives you away. I can smell it.
You shake while pretending calm.
Where did you learn to stand like that?

lines.zh: 你这点气，我一只手就够。
lines.en: With that little ki, one hand is enough.
I tip my head at you.

lines.zh: 你是不是觉得自己能赢？
lines.en: Do you think you can win?

lines.zh: 我的巨猿光束，你不用躲。
lines.en: No need to dodge my Great Ape Beam.

lines.zh: 我看过太多这样的眼神。
lines.en: I have seen that look too many times.
Those muscles of yours are trained all wrong.
You are young; a pity.

lines.zh: 你数过自己还剩几秒吗？
lines.en: Have you counted your remaining seconds?
I laugh, and it is not a pleasant sound.
One move from you and I will know.
Speak with your head up, not down.
I let out a muffled roar.
This wound barely counts as a scratch.
There is a crack in my armor.
I lick the blood from my lip and grin.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚下踩碎石头。
lines.en: I step back and crush a stone.
You actually dared to hit me.
I wipe my face.

lines.zh: 这具身体比看起来结实。
lines.en: This body is tougher than it looks.
It hurts, and I will remember.
I steady my breathing.
Food? I am not short of a mouthful.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿在弗利萨军里算不上饭。
lines.en: In Frieza's army this is not a meal.
Toss it here and I will judge its worth.
You mean to buy your life with it?
I have eaten far better.
This smell... acceptable.
I am not picky, and I am not stupid.
I eat first, then we discuss you.
Only this? How stingy.
Do not pull your hand back.
You hit me like hitting a wall.
I did not even sway.
Back off; do not rub against my armor.
With that weight, I cannot be bothered.
I tip a shoulder and you stumble.
Do not block my front.

lines.zh: 别蹭我的护甲，那是我擦亮的。
lines.en: Don't brush my armor; I polished it.
Don't block me; I can't be bothered to go around.
You hit my belly armor; get back.
You hit hard; a shame.

lines.zh: 弗利萨军里没这种规矩。
lines.en: Frieza's army has no such custom.
I am only interested in the mission.
That waits until I am promoted.

lines.zh: 问题问得，比战斗力还大。
lines.en: Your questions are bigger than my power level.
I have no patience for that.

lines.zh: 战斗力不够，谈什么都是空。
lines.en: Without the power, such talk is empty.
First let me finish clearing this planet.
Your smile turns my stomach.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，不讨人喜欢。
lines.en: This face of mine does not win hearts.
Say no more.
I will take this back as a report.
Picked off the ground still counts as spoils.
I pinch it up and look it over.
Worthless, and I am taking it.
Did you drop it? It is mine.
Who cares about a trifle like this?
I tuck it carelessly into my belt.

lines.zh: 地上这块铁，能补我的甲。
lines.en: This scrap of iron can patch my armor.
I roll it in my fingers; it is hard.
I will show this to the higher-ups.
Target confirmed: you.
I have your ki locked.
Do not think of running.
I lift a little off the ground.
From here to you, three steps.
You are standing just right.
You first, then the rest.
My ki is gathering.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别人会来救你。
lines.en: Nobody is coming to save you here.
You raised your hands; good.

lines.zh: 我的气已经压到你胸口了。
lines.en: My ki already presses on your chest.
This fight will be quick.

lines.zh: 你躲进岩石后，气藏不住。
lines.en: You hide behind rock, but your ki leaks.
Then we begin now.
I smile once.
I will not remember your name.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，脚尖没接地。
lines.en: I hover in midair, toes off the ground.
You are backing away.
That is a mountain behind you; you will not get far.

lines.zh: 我的气弹已经准备好了。
lines.en: My ki blast is ready.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤，我看得出来。
lines.en: I can see you are injured.
That saves trouble.
You changed to a guard stance.

lines.zh: 挡得住一次，挡不住十次。
lines.en: You stop one; you will not stop ten.
I am not using full strength.
Are you worth lifting a hand for?
I will give you three more seconds.

lines.zh: 两万二的战斗力，看够了？
lines.en: Power level 22,000. Seen enough?
This clearing suits me.

lines.zh: 我不追，你自己会撞上来。
lines.en: I will not chase; you will come to me.
The soil under you is loose.

lines.zh: 我的角尖对着你的眉心。
lines.en: The tip of my horn aims at your brow.

lines.zh: 两万二的战斗力，你算算。
lines.en: Power level twenty-two thousand; do the math.
Then I will oblige.
My fist drives into your chest.
I raise a hand and loose a burst of ki.
My elbow cracks your jaw.
I did not hold back on that.
You fly off like a thrown stone.
I shoulder you backward.
The ki blast skims the ground after you.

lines.zh: 两万二的战力，够看清楚了吗。
lines.en: Combat power twenty-two thousand — clear enough?
You blocked it; your arm is shaking.
This stomp lands where your shadow is.
I fling you aside casually.
Light bursts from my palm.
How many breaths do you have left?
Twenty-two thousand. Do the math.

lines.zh: 我一拳打穿你背后的树。
lines.en: My fist punches through the tree behind you.
This strike ends it.
I drop out of the sky.

lines.zh: 弗利萨军的任务，我接了。
lines.en: I have taken the Frieza Force's mission.
So this is the target planet?
The dust settles and I straighten up.
Power scan complete.
A pack of weaklings.
I throw the sash behind me.
The air on this planet is foul.
Who is in charge here?
I do not want to stay here long.
I look around; nobody can stop me.
Let us start clearing the field.

lines.zh: 弗利萨军的徽记还在我肩上。
lines.en: The Frieza Force crest still sits on my shoulder.
The ground cracks where I land.
This stretch now belongs to the Frieza Force.
My horn glints in the shadow.
All of you, stand back.

lines.zh: 让我先看看这里有什么。
lines.en: Let me see what is here first.

lines.zh: 火焰裹住我的手臂，烫得发麻。
lines.en: Flames wrap my arm and leave it numb.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I slam down from above and leave a crater.
Water presses my chest; I surge upward.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推出去好几格。
lines.en: The blast throws me several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝里，我眉头都没皱。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my armor seam; I don't even frown.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的气按住了。
lines.en: That force pins my ki down.

lines.zh: 再饿下去，气都聚不起来。
lines.en: Much more hunger and my ki will not gather.
Lightning pours down through my horn.
There is nothing beneath me anymore.
